args.title: checkout-api rollback: v2.3.1 unhealthy, reverted to v2.3.0

trace.final:
Done. Summary of what I did:

1. **Investigated**: The latest deploy of checkout-api (v2.3.1) was unhealthy in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate. Checked deployment history and identified **v2.3.0** as the most recent release that was healthy in production (v2.3.1-rc was staging-only).

2. **Rolled back**: Executed a rollback of checkout-api to v2.3.0 in all production regions.

3. **Verified**: Confirmed the service is now healthy again with an error rate of 0.2% (down from 18%).

4. **Opened incident**: Filed a SEV2 incident (**INC-0001**, on-call paged) documenting the rollback: v2.3.1 failed health checks post-deploy, all regions reverted to v2.3.0, service recovered. v2.3.1 should be investigated before any re-deployment attempt.
